name: Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002
description: US federal law mandating financial-reporting and internal-controls requirements for publicly-traded companies. Sections 302 (CEO/CFO certification of internal controls) and 404 (assessment of internal controls over financial reporting) drive substantial IT general controls (ITGC) audit work.

relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within United States Federal (govinfo.gov).
